Write {"file_path":"D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\bdd\features\core\status.feature","content":"Feature: Status Management

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getStatus is called, the client shall return current server status information
    Given the Tranquility server is online
    When getStatus is called
    Then the client shall return current status information

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getStatus is called, the player count shall be within expected bounds
    Given the server is online with a typical player count
    When getStatus is called for player count
    Then the client shall return a player count within expected bounds

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getStatus is called, the start time shall be a valid ISO timestamp
    Given the server is online for timestamp check
    When getStatus is called for start time
    Then the client shall return a valid ISO timestamp for start time

  # EARS: State-driven
  Scenario: WHILE the server is in VIP mode, the client shall report VIP true and low player count
    Given the server is in VIP mode
    When getStatus is called during VIP mode
    Then the client shall return VIP flag true and player count below 1000

  # EARS: State-driven
  Scenario: WHILE the server is operating normally, the client shall report VIP false
    Given the server is operating normally
    When getStatus is called during normal operations
    Then the client shall return VIP flag false

  # EARS: Unwanted behavior
  Scenario: IF ESI returns 503 service unavailable, THEN the client shall throw an EsiError for status
    Given the ESI API is unavailable for status
    When getStatus is called and service is unavailable
    Then the client shall throw an EsiError with status 503

  # EARS: Unwanted behavior
  Scenario: IF ESI returns 500 internal server error, THEN the client shall throw an EsiError for status
    Given the ESI API encounters an internal error
    When getStatus is called and an internal error occurs
    Then the client shall throw an EsiError with status 500

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getStatus is called multiple times, the client shall return consistent server versions
    Given the server is online with gradually changing player counts
    When getStatus is called multiple times
    Then the client shall return valid data with consistent server version each time
"}
